deployments_detail.use: GenAI across manufacturing & customer service; AI-designed A320 structural part entering serial production; Mistral AI partnership
Generative AI (RAG method) for aeronautical maintenance; trusted-AI work at ANITI Toulouse
AI-based planning optimization for A330/A350 programs

Skywise open aviation data platform runs predictive/preventive maintenance ('Skywise Predictive Maintenance+') and fleet health analytics for airlines, using AI/ML on aircraft sensor data to anticipate component failures. Built on Palantir Foundry; Airbus renewed its multi-year Palantir contract in Feb 2026. [Palantir (Foundry)]

Multi-year partnership with Mistral AI to deploy 'sovereign' generative AI across all four Airbus divisions (commercial aircraft, helicopters, defence, space), including engineering applications such as crash simulation and defence/space systems, keeping AI infrastructure under European control. [Mistral AI]

CIMON (Crew Interactive Mobile companion) is a free-flying AI robotic astronaut assistant built by Airbus that has flown on the International Space Station, using natural-language processing to help astronauts with procedures and information retrieval. Deployed via CIMON-1 (2018) and improved CIMON-2 (2019). [IBM Watson (NLP)]

Vision-based autonomous flight: the ATTOL (Autonomous Taxi, Take-Off and Landing) program, developed with Airbus's Acubed/Wayfinder team, achieved a 2020 world-first fully automatic vision-based taxi, takeoff and landing of an A350 using onboard image-recognition/ML; Wayfinder continues developing certifiable ML autonomy models across aircraft from 0.8t eVTOL to 315t A350. [Airbus Acubed (in-house ML)]
deployments_detail.value: world-first autonomous vision-based takeoff/taxi/landing (2020); tested across 400x aircraft weight range

deployments_detail.use: Airbus 'Wingman' unmanned collaborative combat aircraft concept: an AI-driven autonomous drone designed to fly alongside crewed Eurofighter jets, performing reconnaissance, jamming and engagement of air/ground targets under human command (loyal-wingman / manned-unmanned teaming). [Airbus Defence and Space]

Enterprise AI program across manufacturing and operations spanning six focus areas: knowledge extraction from unstructured documents, computer vision for image/video analysis (inspection), anomaly detection in datasets, natural-language interaction, complex constrained optimization, and autonomous flight — described by Airbus as active implementations integrated across manufacturing, operations and customer-facing platforms.

Airbus used Palantir Foundry data analytics to manage and accelerate the industrial ramp-up of A350 production, integrating disparate production/supply data to detect bottlenecks and optimize the assembly line. [Palantir (Foundry)]

GenAIR (Airbus's cross-functional generative-AI unit) built a RAG-based generative-AI chatbot on its AWS platform to query technical documentation, draft technical requirements and summarize technical exchanges for engineering/operational teams. Uses AWS Kendra semantic search, OpenSearch, Comprehend for anonymization, LangChain orchestration and open LLMs (Falcon 40B, Llama 2, Mistral). POC built in 5 weeks, presented at AWS Summit Paris. [AWS (Kendra, OpenSearch, Comprehend), LangChain, Falcon 40B / Llama 2 / Mistral]
